library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Do not call VerifierFactory.newInstance() (no-arg or by URI) — it resolves implementations only via META-INF/services/org.iso_relax.verifier.VerifierFactoryLoader, and neither isorelax nor msv-core ship that file, so it will throw VerifierConfigurationException. Instead directly instantiate an MSV factory class, e.g. `new com.sun.msv.verifier.jarv.TheFactoryImpl()` (or RELAXCoreFactoryImpl/RELAXNGFactoryImpl for a specific schema language), then exercise `compileSchema(InputSource)` -> `Schema.newVerifier()` -> `Verifier.verify(...)`/`getVerifierHandler()` against a small embedded RELAX Core (.rxm) or RELAX NG (.rng) schema and both a valid and invalid XML instance, to cover org.iso_relax.verifier's Verifier, VerifierHandler, VerifierFilter, Schema, and exception classes. Do not use jp.gr.xml.relax.swift.SwiftVerifierFactory — it is non-functional without an unpublished proprietary engine.
risks: msv-core (2022.7) is a much newer artifact than isorelax (2003); confirm at test time that its transitive deps (xsdlib, relaxngDatatype, optional xerces/xml-resolver) resolve cleanly and don't conflict with anything else in the test classpath.

If reviewers prefer isorelax to be tested in complete isolation (no companion library), this dependency should be reconsidered — but without it, no test can drive real schema validation, only class loading/exception construction.
